lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in three to four roughly horizontal rows posterior to the pectoral fin, with the highest-intensity local maxima concentrated in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal blob rows to form a coarse grid-like pattern, most visible between the pectoral fin and the first dorsal fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature with a sharp light-to-shadow vertical gradient runs horizontally across the upper third of the flank, extending from the gill region towards the caudal peduncle.
